inferTasksFromScripts.title: inferTasksFromScripts
inferTasksFromScripts.description: Automatically infer moon tasks from package.json scripts or deno.json tasks. Some caveats to be aware of:  - Lifecycle (pre, post) scripts are not inferred. - Outputs will be automatically detected (if possible). - Script names that contain : will be converted to -. - Script names that contain dev, start, serve, or preview will be considered local only.
inferTasksFromScripts.markdownDescription: Automatically infer moon tasks from `package.json` scripts or `deno.json` tasks. Some caveats to be aware of:  - Lifecycle (pre, post) scripts are not inferred. - Outputs will be automatically detected (if possible). - Script names that contain `:` will be converted to `-`. - Script names that contain `dev`, `start`, `serve`, or `preview` will be considered local only.
